name: sii-style-teacher-readout-8gpu
description: Finite phase B on multiselect train+dev: 8 transformer replicas, 2 chains per row. For every chain and candidate, retain the full question/options/reasoning and explicitly ask candidate membership; project the tokenizer-verified Yes and No output logits and use q_i=softmax([Yes,No])[Yes]. Readout and generation must use the same teacher view/checkpoint. Length-truncated chains are excluded and counted; missing or invalid readouts remain null, never negative labels. Per-chain membership/provenance supports downstream component mixtures; no empirical joint or calibration claim is made. Writes runs/qz/sii_style_teacher/<view>/q/membership/exclude/merged and a coverage summary. Configuration only: no job is submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
TEACHER_VIEW=${TEACHER_VIEW:-direct}
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz"
status=0
REASONING=0 READOUT=1 SHARDS=8 SAMPLES=2 MAX_TOKENS=1024 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 MAX_NUM_SEQS=128 GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.9 REASONING_BATCH=32 READOUT_BATCH=4 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 MAX_PHASE_SECONDS=21600 Q_TRANSFORM=membership TRUNCATED_POLICY=exclude TEACHER_ID="Qwen3.5-4B:${TEACHER_VIEW}" TEACHER_VIEW="$TEACHER_VIEW" MODEL="$R/models/Qwen3.5-4B" DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect" RUN_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh > "$R/logs/qz/sii_style_teacher_readout_${TEACHER_VIEW}.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
printf 'JOB EXIT=%s\n' "$status"
exit "$status"
